# Introduction

The Personal chest is a small chest with six item slots, and is accessible only to its owner.

## Tips

• Since only the owner of the chest can dismantle it with a Hammer, the only other way to remove a personal chest is to destroy it with a weapon.
• Even a Black metal weapon can take several minutes to destroy a fully repaired personal chest due to the high durability.
